Guinness Float

Served at: Saint Patrick's Day

Serves 2Prep 5 min

A festive and surprisingly delicious dessert-drink, the Guinness Float combines the rich, malty notes of stout with creamy vanilla ice cream. It's a simple yet indulgent treat perfect for celebrating Saint Patrick's Day, offering a unique twist on a classic float that both adults and those with a sweet tooth will enjoy.

Ingredients

  • 1 pint (473 ml) Guinness stout (or other dry Irish stout), chilled
  • 4 scoops (about 1 cup / 240 ml) vanilla ice cream
  • Optional: chocolate syrup or whipped cream for garnish

Method

  1. Chill two tall glasses or pint glasses in the freezer for at least 10 minutes.
  2. Place two scoops of vanilla ice cream into the bottom of each chilled glass.
  3. Slowly pour half a pint (about 237 ml) of chilled Guinness stout over the ice cream in each glass.
  4. Pour gently down the side of the glass to minimize foam, allowing it to settle for a moment.
  5. Top with additional stout if desired, ensuring the ice cream is mostly submerged.
  6. Serve immediately with a spoon and a straw.
  7. For an extra treat, drizzle with chocolate syrup or top with a dollop of whipped cream before serving.

Tips

  • For best results, use a very cold stout and very cold glasses to keep the ice cream from melting too quickly.
  • Experiment with different ice cream flavors like coffee or chocolate for a richer experience that complements the stout's roasted notes.
  • Pouring slowly and tilting the glass slightly can help reduce excessive foam, making for a cleaner float.
